title: Community garden buddy
summary: Help neighbours plant vegetables and look after raised beds at a shared garden.

title: Community pantry packer
summary: Sort donated groceries and assemble food parcels for local households.

title: Digital drop-in helper
summary: Show library visitors how to use a smartphone and build confidence online.

title: Telephone companion
summary: Offer a friendly conversation and regular listening time to an isolated neighbour.
tasks: Listen on a call|Record a check-in

title: Repair café assistant
summary: Join a workbench team repairing small household items and learning simple fixes.

title: Local history transcriber
summary: Turn scanned handwritten letters into text for a local history collection.

title: Riverside litter walk
summary: Keep the riverside path tidy by picking up litter with a small walking group.

title: Reading practice partner
summary: Read short stories with adult learners and practise English pronunciation.

title: Community kitchen cook
summary: Prepare vegetables and cook simple meals alongside the community kitchen team.

title: Community poster designer
summary: Design accessible publicity posters for local arts events using supplied text and images.

title: Welcome desk greeter
summary: Greet visitors at a neighbourhood centre and explain which local services run that day.

title: Website usability tester
summary: Try sample journeys on a charity website and write up any usability issues.

title: Park wildlife recorder
summary: Observe birds in a park and record a simple wildlife count alongside other volunteers.

title: Seed library sorter
summary: Label donated seed packets for the library and prepare planting information cards.

title: Community audio caption editor
summary: Create captions for short recorded interviews to make local arts stories easier to follow.
